title: Eagle Eye Spotter
description: Zoom your detective eyes across busy comic scenes to catch sneaky time-travel bloopers, hidden Easter eggs, and absurd details before time runs out.
controls: Scan the illustrated scene carefully and tap every suspicious or out-of-place detail to complete the checklist.

zh-CN.title: 我眼力超强
zh-CN.description: 抖音爆款眼力找茬神作我眼力超强：在满屏细节的魔性插画里揪出穿越穿帮与离谱隐藏彩蛋，专治大意眼花！
zh-CN.controls: 仔细观察趣味场景画面，点击揪出所有不合理或隐藏的穿帮细节即可过关。
